_note: Plain words for a frequency band, and mechanics' rules of thumb for what a change there often means. The rules come from general maintenance practice; MIMII does not say which fault each clip is, so they are not validated by this project. Edit freely.

louder.low rumble: often a sign of imbalance or something loose
louder.deep hum: often a sign of misalignment or a worn belt
louder.high-pitched whine: often a sign of bearing wear
louder.hiss or squeal: often a sign of bearing wear or rubbing; on a pump, cavitation or a blockage

quieter: part of its normal sound has dropped away; often a slipping belt or a blockage
